title: How your estimate is worked out
disclaimer: This simulator gives an illustrative estimate only. It is not a loan approval, pre-approval or credit decision, and it is not financial or legal advice. Final terms are confirmed by the lender after a full assessment.

whatWeLookAt.title: What we look at
whatWeLookAt.item1: Your monthly income and your monthly living expenses.
whatWeLookAt.item3: The loan amount and the repayment term you choose.
whatWeLookAt.item4: The interest rate and any fees that apply to the loan.

definitions.title: Instalment, total repayment and total cost
definitions.instalmentDescription: What you would pay each month towards the loan.
definitions.totalRepaymentDescription: Every instalment added together over the full term.
definitions.borrowingCostDescription: The total repayment minus the amount you borrowed — in other words, the interest and fees you pay on top.

assumptions.title: Assumptions
assumptions.body: The estimate assumes the interest rate and term stay the same for the whole loan and that you make every instalment on time. In practice, rates can change and fees vary, so your real cost may differ. A lower loan amount, a shorter term or a lower interest rate usually lowers the total borrowing cost.
